issues.name: Phone number login rejected or check-number error
issues.description: Users entering their mobile number get 'check your number', 'try with different number', or OTP failures and cannot log in with it.

issues.name: Persistent 'Something went wrong' error on login
issues.description: Login fails with a generic 'Something went wrong' or 'try again' message that persists despite reinstalling or clearing cache.

issues.name: False 'no internet connection' error while online
issues.description: App reports no internet or offline status even though the device has working Wi-Fi or mobile data and other apps function normally.

issues.name: Logged out unexpectedly and cannot log back in
issues.description: The account is logged out without prompting (often after an update or closing the app) and the user then cannot sign back in, including rejected passwords.

issues.name: Password recovery and login-without-password not working
issues.description: Users cannot reset or recover a forgotten password, and the 'login without password' option fails or is unavailable.

issues.name: Facebook or Google sign-in problems and linked account loss
issues.description: Login through Facebook or Google fails, or users lose access to accounts linked to a Facebook profile they no longer have.

issues.name: App won't open or shows blank library after update
issues.description: App fails to open, shows only a green icon, or displays a black screen with no playlists, liked songs, or library content after updating or reinstalling.

issues.name: Regional and age restriction access blocks
issues.description: Users are blocked from using the app in certain countries such as Iran, or are rejected for entering a birth year such as 2013, or cannot install on certain devices like Galaxy Watch.

issues.name: Other access problems
issues.description: access complaints that fit no named issue

issues.name: Skips limited to six per hour
issues.description: Free users complain they can only skip a capped number of songs (e.g., 6 per hour or per day).

issues.name: Cannot choose specific songs without premium
issues.description: Free users cannot pick a specific song to play, restricted to shuffle or Spotify-chosen tracks.

issues.name: Lyrics locked behind premium paywall
issues.description: Viewing or loading song lyrics now requires a premium subscription.

issues.name: Seeking and rewinding restricted to premium
issues.description: Free users cannot scrub, rewind, forward, or jump to parts of a song without paying.

issues.name: Playlist and repeat features gated to premium
issues.description: Free users cannot play playlists in order, repeat tracks, or turn off shuffle without premium.

issues.name: Premium purchase fails or won't process
issues.description: Users cannot subscribe or buy premium: the payment screen does not appear, connection errors occur, or gift cards are rejected.

issues.name: Charged after cancelling or missed payment
issues.description: Users report being billed after unsubscribing or confusion over charges and payment status.

issues.name: Premium price too high
issues.description: Users say the premium subscription costs too much and call for lower prices.

issues.name: Other billing problems
issues.description: billing complaints that fit no named issue

issues.name: Lyrics not loading or missing
issues.description: Complaints that lyrics fail to display, show 'Couldn't load the lyrics', are missing for specific songs, or are wrong.

issues.name: Shuffle and playlists playing unwanted recommended songs
issues.description: Complaints that recommended or unrelated songs are inserted into the user's own playlists or that playback ignores the chosen playlist.

issues.name: Shuffle repeats the same songs repeatedly
issues.description: Complaints that shuffle, radio, or recommendations keep cycling the same small set of songs, including artist radio stations.

issues.name: Songs missing or unavailable in catalog
issues.description: Complaints that specific songs, artists, or regional music (Indian, Bhojpuri, Zee, Bhajan, soundtracks) are absent, removed, or unavailable.

issues.name: Wrong song plays when selected
issues.description: Complaints that tapping a song plays a different track, or that search returns no results for a requested song.

issues.name: Removed or altered songs in user playlists
issues.description: Complaints that songs disappear from playlists or get swapped for clean versions without the user's action.

issues.name: Artist top songs and discovery features removed
issues.description: Complaints that the artist page no longer shows top songs or that discovery and navigation features have been taken away in an update.

issues.name: Premium paywall for basic features
issues.description: Complaints that features such as rewinding, repeating songs, or queueing, or listening to chosen songs, require a paid Premium subscription.

issues.name: Other catalog problems
issues.description: catalog complaints that fit no named issue

issues.name: Downloaded songs won't play offline
issues.description: Downloaded music, podcasts, or playlists fail to start or play when there is no internet or cell signal, or the app keeps trying to connect.

issues.name: Downloads disappear or get deleted
issues.description: Previously downloaded songs, playlists, or podcasts vanish or are removed, often after updates, phone resets, or time passing, and must be downloaded again.

issues.name: Cannot download songs without Premium
issues.description: Free or non-subscribed users are unable to download any songs for offline listening.

issues.name: Downloads re-download endlessly
issues.description: Adding a song or reopening the app causes the whole playlist or downloaded content to re-download repeatedly, or downloads get stuck in the background.

issues.name: Offline library loads very slowly
issues.description: Opening downloaded songs or playlists with no internet takes a very long time to load instead of opening immediately.

issues.name: Playlists or library content missing or empty
issues.description: Playlists, albums, liked songs, or saved albums show zero songs, do not appear, or disappear from the library after saving.

issues.name: Local files missing or not playing
issues.description: Local audio files do not appear, cannot be added, are marked unplayable, or are not shown in liked songs.

issues.name: Cannot save downloads to SD card
issues.description: Downloads cannot be stored on an SD card or storage location, the option to change storage location was removed, or moving storage fails and deletes content.

issues.name: Other downloads problems
issues.description: downloads complaints that fit no named issue

issues.name: Basic features removed in latest update
issues.description: Complaints that a recent update removed core functionality that users relied on, making the app less useful.

issues.name: App not working or not opening after update
issues.description: Reports that the app fails to work, will not open, or is unusable, including inability to open features like Spotify Wrap.

issues.name: Buggy app with glitches after update
issues.description: Complaints describing the app as buggy, glitchy, or full of software problems.

issues.name: Podcast host controversy driving boycott
issues.description: Complaints objecting to Spotify content or a host (e.g., Joe Rogan) and misinformation, leading users to refuse to use the app.

issues.name: Offensive content tied to country or religion
issues.description: Hateful or offensive remarks targeting a country, Sweden, or Muslims, and related boycott statements.

issues.name: Users switching to competing music apps
issues.description: Complaints stating users are leaving Spotify for alternatives such as Gaana or JioSaavn.

issues.name: App quality declined from previously good version
issues.description: Complaints that the app used to be good or the best but has become the worst after changes, with requests to restore the old version.

issues.name: General hate and uninstall requests
issues.description: Non-specific expressions of hatred, calls to delete or uninstall the app, or one-word negative reviews with no concrete problem named.

issues.name: Playback stops or pauses mid-song
issues.description: Songs or podcasts stop, pause, or cut out in the middle of playback without user action, sometimes resuming from the start or switching tracks.

issues.name: Wrong song plays when a different one is selected
issues.description: Tapping or searching for a specific song, album, or playlist track starts a different track instead, or auto-queues unrelated songs.

issues.name: Songs skip or next track fails to play
issues.description: Tracks are skipped at random, the next song in a playlist or queue does not start, or playback jumps ahead without the user choosing it.

issues.name: Cannot play liked or saved songs
issues.description: Liked Songs or saved music will not play, or tapping them opens an album view or does nothing instead of starting playback.

issues.name: Shuffle and repeat function broken
issues.description: Shuffle only cycles a small set of songs or repeats the same tracks, and repeat or loop options do not work as expected.

issues.name: Podcast buffering, skipping, or video missing
issues.description: Podcasts buffer constantly, skip mid-episode, fail to load, or podcast video cannot be viewed.

issues.name: App crashes or freezes during playback
issues.description: The app closes unexpectedly, freezes, or stops responding while music is playing or while used alongside other apps.

issues.name: App stuck on loading or offline error
issues.description: The app hangs on the splash or loading screen, takes minutes to load, or wrongly reports no internet or offline status despite a working connection.

issues.name: Other playback problems
issues.description: playback complaints that fit no named issue

issues.name: Support agents ignore or delay replies
issues.description: Customers say their messages to support go unanswered or are read and ignored for long periods.

issues.name: Support takes hours to resolve simple issues
issues.description: Customers report that even easy problems require hours of back-and-forth with support before being fixed.

issues.name: Subscription cancelled without customer consent
issues.description: Customers say a support rep cancelled their subscription without telling them or getting their agreement.

issues.name: Free trial converts to paid charge unexpectedly
issues.description: Customers say they were offered a free trial or promo but were charged the following month anyway.

issues.name: Rude or accusatory support staff
issues.description: Customers feel support agents were disrespectful, called them liars, or demanded proof without basis.

issues.name: Support email form broken or missing
issues.description: Customers cannot find a way to send a support email, or the email contact form glitches out when they try.

issues.name: Audiobook purchase flow broken after update
issues.description: Premium users say the recent update made buying audiobooks require hoops or stopped working.

issues.name: Cannot find or recover accidentally hidden songs
issues.description: Users who hid a song by accident cannot locate it in recently played or hidden songs settings to restore it.

issues.name: Excessive ads on free plan
issues.description: Complaints that ads are too frequent, appear every few songs, or are irritating and intrusive for free users.

issues.name: Cannot shuffle or shuffle stuck on
issues.description: Shuffle cannot be turned off or changed, or shuffle does not work when pressed, so songs play in an unwanted order.

issues.name: Cannot skip, repeat, or seek within songs
issues.description: After the update users cannot skip tracks freely, repeat a song, go back, or jump to a specific part of a song.

issues.name: Playlist plays unrelated or random songs
issues.description: Playlists play songs the user did not add, or random songs are inserted or played instead of the chosen track or playlist.

issues.name: Playlist editing fails or songs cannot be removed
issues.description: Editing a playlist jumps to the top, changes won't save, songs can't be removed, or playlists disappear from the library.

issues.name: New UI is confusing and hard to navigate
issues.description: Complaints that the redesigned interface, homepage, auto-play tiles, or navigation is cluttered, confusing, or unusable.

issues.name: Playback bar disappears and app freezes
issues.description: The now-playing bar vanishes, the app stops or crashes when opening links, or the playback controls and slider stop responding.

issues.name: Lyrics missing or not loading
issues.description: Lyrics fail to load or are unavailable for most songs, or lack translation.
